parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-10 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104.3 | 6.31 | 6.31
2 | 416.7 | 17.57 | 23.88
3 | 264.5 | 2.29 | 26.17
4 | 856.9 | 2.63 | 28.80
5 | 641.5 | 26.88 | 55.68
6 | 7698.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHKH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-10
Curve type: KHKH
Aquifer depth: 28.8 - 55.7 m
Recommendation: Target the thick weathered zone between 28.8 m and 55.7 m. Drill to a total depth of approximately 56 m to ensure full interception of the aquifer.
